evaluation_notes.audience: offline analyst only; never injected as runtime observations
mechanisms: 059-06 invalidates neck fit, derived volume and saved-model snapshot transitively. Base/body fits and frame_reader remain unchanged.
Region cuts retain shared image scale, coordinate frame and symmetry-axis evidence. No screen ROI crop or pixel detector is implemented here.
Point labels, spans and numerical values are synthetic. No ground-truth volume, edge map or official reward is supplied to the agent.
Official v2.1 evaluation must use the installed task class via examples.osworld2_eval, independently of this replay.
